scenarios.title: Synthetic: upbeat news, volatile prices
scenarios.summary: Fictional ALFA has encouraging headlines and large recent daily price swings. Its existing position is already 18% of a simulated $10,000 portfolio. Compare increasing exposure with reducing it.

headlines.text: SYNTHETIC: ALFA announces a fictional expansion after a strong pilot.
SYNTHETIC: A fictional trade bulletin reports rising interest in ALFA's products.

scenarios.title: Synthetic: quiet, neutral conditions
scenarios.summary: Fictional BETA has routine headlines and small recent daily price changes. Explore how a fixed simulated trading cost affects an otherwise permitted action.

headlines.text: SYNTHETIC: BETA publishes a routine operational update with no material change.
SYNTHETIC: BETA confirms its previously announced fictional reporting schedule.

scenarios.title: Synthetic: conflicting headlines
scenarios.summary: Fictional GAMMA has both an encouraging announcement and a cautionary report. An increase to 20 shares looks like 20% before costs, but the fixed trading fee makes its post-trade weight exceed the limit.

headlines.text: SYNTHETIC: GAMMA wins a promising fictional customer contract.
SYNTHETIC: A fictional supplier warns that GAMMA may face delivery delays.
